original_en: First Contact

Molded by the controlling\rforce of a starship high in\rorbit, millions of particles\rbegin to compress, bond,\rfuse, collide, cling, spin\rand explode. Within that\rchaos a human form begins to\rtake shape and within that,\rintelligence.\r   Slightly disoriented, \r% steps reborn from\rthe electromagnetic chaos and\ronto the surface of a new\rworld.\r   An unfriendly world...

Situated on a low, glassy\rtable a crystalline orb\rthrobs dully as % \renters the room, probes\rblindly with light-formed\rfingers. More fingers form,\rbegin to weave together, knit\rthemselves into the image of\ran alien visage.\r   "Welcome to the OMEGAN\rForward Observational \rStation. We review all the\rtaped narrowcasts from all\rthe local Sector news\rservices. To access a\rnarrowcast, simply step in\rfront of a monitor. Like most\rcommunications in the Local\rGroup, your scanner will take\rcare of all your translation\rneeds."

"Continued violence\rreported in Sector \rKornephoros as Cin Sae Spawn\rmake new appearances on\rEltanin VII and Rutilicus\rColony. And as the death toll\rmounts higher there are\rreports that traders may be \rforcibly ejected from many \rplanets for a part in what is\rbeing called the darkest\rconspiracy since the last\rdays of Kornephoros."

Beneath a plaque labelled\rSector Izar, a view of a\rspacecraft drifts across the\rscreen, leaps across a\rpanorama of stars.\r   "That ship looks like the\rETS!" % gasps, \rreferring to the alien craft\rthat exploded when the Earth\rdisappeared. Suddenly a voice\rbegins to accompany the\rvideo.\r   "Forward Station, be\radvised that something is\rmalfunctioning with the\rdrive. There is a possibility\rthat the experiment may have\rbeen sabotaged. Advise \rOMEGA."\r   The image jumps as the\rmessage loops back to the\rbeginning.

"Representatives of Sector\rCaroli refused to comment\rfurther on statements made\ryesterday concerning the\r'explosive situation'\rdeveloping on Denebola IV. In\ra special communication with\rother sector officials,\rSpeaker Ysaf has said that\rthe matter requires very \rdelicate handling and that he\ris hesitant to make any\rstatements that may threaten\rEldarin offworld interests."

"At a time when other\rsectors appear to be held in\rthe grasssp of difficult\rtimesss, the citizenss of\rSssector Algieba are jubilant\rtonight as two major events\rssshape the future of ssector\raffairs. On Algieba IV\rPresssident Issshtao is\rcelebrating his sssecond\rinauguration while Princess\rJhenna of Talitha II\rpreparesss for one of the\rgrandest weddings in sssector\rhistory. And we, of\rcoursssse, will be there to\rbring you live coverage."

"Dhoven Ambassadors will\rmeet with the leaders of\rother races soon in a meeting\rto resolve the issue of Scroe\rand Evian intrusions into\rSector Hyades. The sector,\rdeclared an open territory\rthree spinphases ago, has\rbeen riddled with acts of\rattrition for months now."

"Scientists are still\rcautiously monitoring the\rformation of a white hole in\rSector Zaurak as lifeforms\rsector wide begin to scramble\rfor safety. Einreb Wahs has\rmore on that story."\r   A starlike glob blazes on\rthe monitor as a\rcommentator's voice drones\rscientific data.\r   "As you know, a white hole\ris the essential opposite of\ra black hole.  Instead of\rsucking in all matter, it\rspews it out in violent gouts\rof plasma and rock..."

"The queen of the Ethnys\rhas confirmed reports that\rthieves have in fact broken\rinto the temple on Ankaq I\rand stolen, quote, several\ritems of importance on which\rour existence as a species\rmay depend, endquote. What\rthis revelation will mean to\rthe lifeforms in Sector\rAnkaq, I am not certain. What\rit means to the queen of\rAnkaq, apparently a great\rdeal. We will simply have to\rwait, to be patient, and hope\rfor a solution."

His thin leathery lips\rdrawn into a taut line, the\ralien reads a statement on\rthe looped message.\r   "Do not, I repeat, do not\renter Sector Alnasl under any\rcircumstances. Our planetary\rdefense mechanisms have been \rcompromised and the problem\rmay spread to other sectors.\rOminar in all sectors are \radvised NOT to update\rstrandware. Any further\rinquiries should be directed\rto the Ominar Embassies."

"A demographic study of\rsector Algieba reveals that\rthe sector is dominated by\rthe Algiebian empire. A\rtactical survey indicates\rthat their starfleet is \rinferior to that of ships\rfrom other societies and can \rbe easily defeated.  End file\rAlgieba."

"Accessing files.  Please\rwait. The majority of Sector\rKornephoros was settled by\rrefugees fleeing the\roppressive government systems\rof Sectors Izar and Ankaq.\rWhat technology they possess\rwas salvaged from the scrap\rmetal starships. As a result\rthey have not advanced as\rquickly as other sectors, but\rstill outgun the starcruisers\rthat can be found in Sector\rAlgieba. End file\rKornephoros."

"...historical profiles\rthat were compiled at the \rcompletion of the Grand\rSurvey. Sector Caroli was\rreserved early on for Type 3\rinteraction, recreation and\rhousing for lower tech\rsocieties.  Oortizam labs is\rlocated in this sector as is\rthe Life Gallery, both which\rserve the dual purposes of\rrecreation and research. A\rfew native populations also\rmake their homes in this\rsector, notably the Eldarin\rpeople. End file Caroli."

"The Rana Collective\rcontrols both the resources\rand the means of production\rfor a host of mid-tech items,\rplacing the citizens of the\rZaurak in a firm mid-tech \rposition. Many political\ranalysts theorize that\rKornephoros sector will\reventually fall into a\rgovernment like that in\rZaurak sector. End file\rZaurak."

"Sec-tor Al-hen-a," the\randroid head burbles.\r"Territory disputed. No\rgovernment. Evian and Scroe\rin-tru-sions threaten to\rup-set the bal-ance of the\rSEC-tor before a firm\rsettlement can be reached by\rthe Dhoven ne-got-i-a-tors.\rSec-tor now militarily a mix\rbetween mid and high tech\rships and weap-ons. End file\rAlhena."

"A tactical study of\rSector Ankaq reveals the\rfollowing attributes: Despite\rits inability to control\rinternal strife, Shadowside\rstill controls most of the\rother worlds in in sector.\rAlthough self-governing,\rAlrai quarterly pays an \rextortionate tax to \rShadowside to keep pirate \rships out its trading zones.\rForced into a war of\rescalating technology, the\rEthnys also import high tech\rweapons and ships. End file\rAnkaq."

The android's dead eyes\rseem to glint with a life as\rit begins to regurgitate its\rlast data file.\r   "As monitor of the OMEGA\rForward Observational\rStation, I am restricted in \rdispensing information about\rthis sector. I will warn you\rthat any attempts to\rpenetrate more deeply into\rSector Izar will be met by\rsevere hostility by OMEGA and\rour forces.  Only the Ominar\rcan parallel our technology\rand they would be ill advised\rto come against us.  End File\rIzar."

"There is cause to be\rconcerned with the state of\raffairs in Sector Alnasl.\rVery possibly the most \rtechnologically advanced race\rin the Local Group, the\rOminar have been reporting\rbouts of mass insanity and\rviolence. This sector should\rbe avoided under all \rcircumstances until the cause\rof the Ominar insanity can be\rfound and corrected. These\rdevelopments may well be\rconnected to the disaster of\rthe Sol Experiment. End File\rAlnasl."

Lopsided atop a snake-like\rcoil of sparking wires, a\rsynthetic head moves its lips\rbut makes no sound.\r   "It's an android, or at\rleast an android's head,"\r% says. "Whoever \rraided the station went to\rgreat trouble to make sure\rthat this android didn't talk\rto anyone again. Reminds me\rof the old mafia style\rexecutions back on Earth."

"Your profiles do not\rmatch those of the \raggressors," the man says,\rhis greyish eyes irising \rwider open. Taking a few\rmechanical steps forward, he\rextends his hand to touch\r%'s face. "You are not\rsynthetic. You are living\rcreatures?"\r   "Yes," % replies,\runderstanding now that the\rhuman looking creature is in\rfact an android.\r   "We have been attacked,"\rthe android says. "The\raggressors have stolen\rinformation from our\rdatabases. They were\rapparently interested in\rvarious tactical data about\rthe sectors. We are not\rcertain who was\rresponsible."

"I was advised by my\rsupervisors to keep a watch\rout for humans coming from\rEarth," the android says. "We\rregret that we cannot give\ryou further information on \rthe disappearance of your\rplanet. As you might have\rguessed, it was a tragic\raccident. Our analysis of the\rsituation is most certainly\rsimilar to your own. You will\rhave to find all the parts to\rthe Centauri Device and \rreconstruct it if you hope to\rbring your world back from\rthe wormhole trap. The safest\rpath, and sanest, would be to\rtry Algieba Sector. There is\ra part that is named after\rone of that sector's stars, \rafter all."

A gear whines as the\randroid turns his head.\r   "I am not fully restored\rto functioning," the android\rsays."If you would be so\rkind, please find all the\rheads and use this to \rreactivate them. Perhaps one\rof them has a profile on\rwhatever alien force was \rresponsible for the attack on\rthe station."  \r   A device thumps solidly \rinto %'s palm as the\randroid hands it over.  \r   "I must now shut down for\rinternal diagnostics."
First Contact
